name: Bitter & Sweet
source:
A collection of three short stories:

1. Main heroine tries to give chocolate to school idol Ayano on Valentine's Day, but ends up receiving chocolate from different people
2. Student council chairman favors kouhai and confesses to her under the cherry blossoms on the Christmas night.
3. Main character enters Spring with fresh aspirations and has a special encounter that gives birth to new feeling.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-april-2006-tenshitsuki-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
